gizmo.title: Dejupụta oghere
gizmo.description: Ọrụ nyocha ebe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-emezu okwu ndị na-efu n'okwu.

configure.title: Okwu
configure.description: Okwu a ga-atụgharị ka ọ bụrụ mmekọrịta "kaa okwu ndị ahụ akara".

configure.description: OER Schema: ebumnuche mmụta jikọtara na nyocha a.

configure.title: Kọọsị
configure.description: OER Schema: kọọsị e mere nyocha a maka ya.

developer.title: Aha ule
developer.description: Aha ule e zigara maka iji na gburugburu xAPI iji mata ihe a

advanced.title: Nke a pụrụ ịkpọchi
advanced.description: Gosi ajụjụ a dị ka ahịrị nke na-emepe ma na-emechi. Imepe otu na-emechi ajụjụ ndị ọzọ a pụrụ ịkpọchi nke dị n'akụkụ ya.

advanced.title: Malite ya ka emechiri
advanced.description: Mgbe a pụrụ ịkpọchi, malite dị ka ahịrị emechiri nke na-egosi naanị ajụjụ na ọnọdụ ya.
